entries.korean: 내가 더 빨리 많은 포켓몬을 모았는데!
entries.gloss: But I collected lots of Pokémon faster than you!
...Would they be happy to get it?
There's no room to put it...
Looks like someone was cooking something!

entries.korean: 이길 자신이 있다면 웅이랑 배틀해 봐!
entries.gloss: If you think you can win, go battle Brock!
But a TM can only be used once!
It's tough and has great endurance!

entries.korean: 서로 선택한 것이 다른 것 같습니다
entries.gloss: It seems you each chose something different.
It's good to battle trainers a lot, too!

entries.korean: 얼어버리면 전혀 움직일 수 없게 됩니다!
entries.gloss: Once it's frozen, it can't move at all!

entries.korean: 확실한 건 지금까지의 관장 중에서 누구보다도 강하다는 거야!
entries.gloss: One thing's for sure: they're stronger than any Gym Leader so far!

entries.korean: 그래 꽤나 잘 따르는 것 같은데?
entries.gloss: I see, it seems quite attached to you.

entries.korean: 최근 달맞이산에서 귀중한 포켓몬의 화석을 연속으로 훔치는 악당이 있습니다!
entries.gloss: Lately a villain has been stealing precious Pokémon fossils from Mt. Moon one after another!

entries.korean: 여기서는 세상에서 보기 힘든 고대 포켓몬 화석 중 2종류를 전시하고 있습니다!
entries.gloss: Here we're displaying two kinds of ancient Pokémon fossils that are rarely seen in this world!

entries.korean: 땅을 강하게 흔들어서 상대에게 큰 데미지를 주는!
entries.gloss: Shakes the ground hard to deal big damage to the opponent!

entries.korean: 포켓몬은 타입에 따라 유리한 타입 불리한 타입이 있다네
entries.gloss: Depending on their type, Pokémon have types they're strong against and types they're weak against.
Wild Pokémon jump out from tall grass!
When there's something you don't know: HELP!
Thinking of nicknames is fun... but hard!
It's good to battle trainers a lot, too!

entries.korean: 바위를 상대에게 던져서 스피드를 떨어뜨려 버리는 재미있는 기술이지!
entries.gloss: It's a fun move that throws rocks at the opponent and lowers its Speed!
I'll give you a tool you'll need!
It has a small brain in its tail.
You take one you like, too!

entries.korean: 여기는 태초마을 태초는 새하얀 시작의 색
entries.gloss: This is Pallet Town. Pallet is the pure white color of beginnings.

entries.korean: 지닌 포켓몬에 데려갈 수 없는 포켓몬이 있습니다
entries.gloss: There's a Pokémon in your party that can't be taken along.
Prof. Oak: Come and visit me once in a while!
...You and your Pokémon are really in sync.

entries.korean: 먼 옛날 나무에서 나온 액체가 화석처럼 굳은 것을 호박이라고 한단다
entries.gloss: Long ago, sap from trees hardened like a fossil; that's called amber.

entries.korean: 아무래도 이 체육관엔 땅타입 포켓몬을 쓰는 사람이 모여있나봐
entries.gloss: It looks like people who use Ground-type Pokémon gather at this Gym.

entries.korean: 남나리: 사람이랑 똑같이 포켓몬도 살아 있단다!
entries.gloss: Daisy: Pokémon are alive, just like people!
Brock is looking for an opponent... come here!
I'll give you a tool you'll need!
It's fine to weaken it with poison or a burn, too!

entries.korean: 내 손자가 나와서 가르쳐 주니까 당연하겠지!
entries.gloss: My grandson comes and teaches them, so of course!

entries.korean: 꽤 많이 따르는구나 그렇게 계속 귀여워해줘
entries.gloss: It's really attached to you. Keep loving it like that.
It's a pretty picture of a Pokémon!
My friends won't let me get away with this.

entries.korean: 살아 있는 동안에 이 기술을 가르칠 자를 만날 거라곤 생각도 못 했는데
entries.gloss: I never thought I'd meet someone to teach this move to while I was still alive.
Maybe a boulder could block the current...

entries.korean: 먹이를 던지면 먹이에 정신이 팔린 동안 포켓몬이 잘 도망치지 않아!
entries.gloss: If you throw bait, Pokémon won't run away as easily while they're distracted by it!

entries.korean: 가방에 들어 있는 도구를 편리 버튼에 등록할 수 있습니다
entries.gloss: You can register an item in your Bag to the SELECT button.
Ah, that's right, I called you!

entries.korean: 배틀이 끝나도 얼어 있습니다 얼음상태치료제로 안 녹이면 포켓몬이 불쌍합니다
entries.gloss: It stays frozen even after battle. If you don't thaw it with Ice Heal, the poor Pokémon suffers.

entries.korean: 이 이상은 없을 정도로 따르고 있구나...!
entries.gloss: It couldn't be more attached to you...!

entries.korean: 저도 박사님의 조수로서 포켓몬을 연구하고 있습니다
entries.gloss: I'm also researching Pokémon as the Professor's assistant.

entries.korean: 친구랑 2층에 가서 없던 포켓몬을 교환받으면 많이 모여!
entries.gloss: Go to the second floor with a friend and trade for Pokémon you don't have, and you'll collect lots!

entries.korean: 혼란에 빠지면 바로 포켓몬을 교체하는 작전도 좋지
entries.gloss: Switching Pokémon as soon as one gets confused is a good strategy, too.
Name: Kangaskhan. The close-knit family Pokémon!

entries.korean: 머리를 땋은 여자아이가 벽돌길을 걷고 있다...
entries.gloss: A girl with braided hair is walking down the brick road...

entries.korean: 우선 제1섬에 가서 그 근처를 찾아볼까- 그럼 먼저 간다!
entries.gloss: First I'll go to One Island and look around there. I'm heading off first!

entries.korean: 크리티컬커터는 기술이 급소에 맞기 쉬워집니다 도구 구매는 무지개백화점에서!
entries.gloss: Focus Energy makes moves more likely to land critical hits. Buy items at the Celadon Dept. Store!

entries.korean: 도둑이 어질러 놓은 흔적이 남아 있다...
entries.gloss: Traces of the mess the thief left behind remain...
I want to go play again!

entries.korean: 하고 던지면 포켓몬을 잡을 수 있지!
entries.gloss: You throw it like that and you can catch Pokémon!
Looks like all sorts of things could fit in it!

entries.korean: 머리를 땋은 여자아이가 벽돌길을 걷고 있다...
entries.gloss: A girl with braided hair is walking down the brick road...

entries.korean: 엄청 무거운 바위라도 괴력으로 움직일 수 있지!
entries.gloss: With Strength you can move even really heavy boulders!

entries.korean: 칠판에는 배틀 중인 포켓몬에게 일어나는 상태의 변화에 대한 내용이 적혀 있다
entries.gloss: The blackboard describes status changes that happen to Pokémon during battle.
It gets stronger when hit by fire.
The more it has stockpiled, the bigger the damage.
Your pages haven't increased at all?

entries.korean: 키우던 포켓몬이 죽었을 때 포켓몬타워에 데려가서 명복을 빌어주는 거지...
entries.gloss: When a Pokémon you raised dies, you take it to Pokémon Tower and pray for its soul...
Congratulations on beating five in a row!
It's good to raise them slowly!
The wind is blowing my way!
Special feature on Cinnabar Gym Leader Blaine!

entries.korean: 혼란에 빠지면 바로 포켓몬을 교체하는 작전도 좋지
entries.gloss: Switching Pokémon as soon as one gets confused is a good strategy, too.

entries.korean: 꽤 많이 따르는구나 그렇게 계속 귀여워해줘
entries.gloss: It's really attached to you. Keep loving it like that.
I can't push myself that far!
One morning it suddenly comes flying in.

entries.korean: 회색시티 포켓몬 체육관 관장 웅 강하고 딱딱한 바위의 남자
entries.gloss: Pewter City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Brock. The rock-solid, tough man.
Special feature on Saffron Gym Leader Sabrina!
There's a photo of Blaine and Mr. Fuji!

entries.korean: 종류와 레벨이 같은 포켓몬이라도 잡을 때마다 능력이 조금씩 다르고...
entries.gloss: Even Pokémon of the same species and level have slightly different abilities each time you catch one...
This is Mt. Moon... the cave entrance.

entries.korean: 포켓몬 도감이 20종류 모인 것 같으면 박사님이 변함없는돌을 주라고 말씀하셨어요!
entries.gloss: The Professor said to give you an Everstone once you've collected about 20 kinds in your Pokédex!

entries.korean: 있지 앞으로도 여러 트레이너와 배틀해서 멋있는 모습들을 보여줘!
entries.gloss: Hey, keep battling lots of trainers and show me how cool you are!

entries.korean: 너를 얕잡아 봤던 모양이야 나를 이긴 증표로 포켓몬리그 공인 회색배지를 수여할게!
entries.gloss: Looks like I underestimated you. As proof of your victory, I award you the official Pokémon League Boulder Badge!

entries.korean: 달맞이산에서 달의돌이 떨어진 뒤부터 발견되기 시작했대
entries.gloss: I heard they started being found after the Moon Stone fell on Mt. Moon.

entries.korean: 로켓단이 부활할 날까지 이 체육관에서 체제를 정비할 것이다!
entries.gloss: We'll reorganize at this Gym until the day Team Rocket is revived!

entries.korean: 사실은 이미 알고 있지만 몇 번이고 보고 싶어서 말이지!
entries.gloss: Truth is, I already know, but I want to see it again and again!

entries.korean: 삐삐가 달에서 왔다는 소문을 알고 있니?
entries.gloss: Have you heard the rumor that Clefairy came from the moon?
Have you heard the rumor about Bill too?
It's fine to weaken it with poison or a burn, too!
Do you want to play Berry Crush?

entries.korean: 상냥한 탕구리의 어미로 돌아온 영혼은 무사히 하늘로 올라가...
entries.gloss: The spirit, returned to its gentle Cubone mother, safely ascends to the sky...
I'm looking forward to you completing the National Pokédex!

entries.korean: 너한테 들킨 이상 어쩔 수 없군!
entries.gloss: Now that you've found me out, there's nothing I can do!

entries.korean: 무지개시티 포켓몬체육관 관장 민화 자연을 사랑하는 아기씨!
entries.gloss: Celadon City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Erika. The nature-loving princess!

entries.korean: 자신이 있는 장소나 마을의 이름을 알고 싶을 때 타운맵을 쓰면 좋아
entries.gloss: Use the Town Map when you want to know the name of the place or town you're in.
Look closely at what I wrote on the blackboard!
You have something to deliver to me?
For some reason it looks happy!
The number of participants doesn't match.

entries.korean: 포켓몬 무선 클럽 다이렉트 코너에 잘 오셨습니다!
entries.gloss: Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless Club Direct Corner!
With this, you're a member of the Punch club!
Losing to someone younger was the one thing I wanted to avoid!

entries.korean: 매우 긴 혀로 상대를 핥아서 공격한다.
entries.gloss: Attacks by licking the opponent with a very long tongue.
A fossil of the rare ancient Pokémon Aerodactyl.
High chance of landing a critical hit.

entries.korean: 정의감이 강하고 열혈에 멋지고 가장 대단한 사람...!
entries.gloss: Someone with a strong sense of justice, hot-blooded, cool, and the most amazing...!
Don't just start talking to me!

entries.korean: 이건 내가 특별히 주문한 몬스터볼이구나 정말 고맙다!
entries.gloss: This is the Poké Ball I specially ordered. Thank you so much!
Agatha's Ghost Pokémon are frighteningly strong...!
How is it any different from an ordinary pebble?
This is a famous fishing spot.
Flies to a town you know.

entries.korean: 당신도 승부를 내던지지 말고 잘 해보세요
entries.gloss: Don't give up on the match, and do your best too.
There's no room to put it...

entries.korean: 종류와 레벨이 같은 포켓몬이라도 잡을 때마다 능력이 조금씩 다르고...
entries.gloss: Even Pokémon of the same species and level have slightly different abilities each time you catch one...

entries.korean: 프로필은 멋진 단어를 4개 조합해서 만들어 조합하는 단어는 많이 있어!
entries.gloss: You make a profile by combining four cool words. There are lots of words to combine!
Shall I teach your Pokémon Body Slam instead?
Which battle would you like to do?
If the Pokémon is full of energy, it might run away!
How did you get in here?
There's a photo of Blaine and Mr. Fuji!

entries.korean: 이 세상의 모든 포켓몬을 기록한 완벽한 도감을 만드는 것!
entries.gloss: To make a perfect Pokédex that records every Pokémon in the world!
If there were a special item...

entries.korean: 멀리 사는 사촌이 언제나 말했던 것 같은데...?
entries.gloss: I think my cousin who lives far away always used to say that...?
My partner Machoke is incredibly strong!
Is this your first time using wireless communication?
Jumping down is a little scary, but...
It seems to be part of a claw.

entries.korean: 칸나는 지혜를 발휘해서 쿨하게 싸우지만 의외의 일면도 있다는 듯하다?
entries.gloss: Lorelei fights coolly and cleverly, but apparently she has an unexpected side too?

entries.korean: 쓰레기통에 이상한 나무열매가 버려져 있었는데 뭐지?
entries.gloss: A strange berry was thrown away in the trash can... what is it?
Then come back if you change your mind.

entries.korean: 비전기술 플래시로 아무리 어두운 장소라도 제대로 밝아집니다
entries.gloss: With the hidden move Flash, even the darkest places light right up.

entries.korean: 인류 사상 처음으로 달 위에 서다!
entries.gloss: The first person in human history to stand on the moon!

entries.korean: 서로 선택한 것이 다른 것 같습니다
entries.gloss: It seems you each chose something different.

entries.korean: 내 손자가 나와서 가르쳐 주니까 당연하겠지!
entries.gloss: My grandson comes and teaches them, so of course!

entries.korean: 리스트의 순서를 바꾸면 유리해지는 일도 있어!
entries.gloss: Changing the order of the list can give you an advantage!
This one is really easy to raise!

entries.korean: 블루시티 체육관에도 가서 네 힘을 시험해보면 좋을 거야
entries.gloss: You should go to the Cerulean Gym too and test your strength.
Thinking of nicknames is fun... but hard!

entries.korean: 각지의 포켓몬체육관에서는 언제나 격렬한 배틀이 펼쳐지고 있다!
entries.gloss: Fierce battles are always taking place at Pokémon Gyms all over!

entries.korean: 진짜로 진정한 엄청나게 멋지고 완벽한 포켓몬 도감을 완성시켰구나...!
entries.gloss: You really completed a truly amazing, perfect Pokédex...!

entries.korean: 엄마: ...맞아 사내아이는 언젠가 여행을 떠나지 응...
entries.gloss: Mom: ...That's right, all boys leave on a journey someday, yes...
This is Route 19 Sea Route, Fuchsia City...
You're worthy of the old man's notice!

entries.korean: 이 세상의 모든 포켓몬을 기록한 완벽한 도감을 만드는 것!
entries.gloss: To make a perfect Pokédex that records every Pokémon in the world!
For some reason it looks fun!

entries.korean: 어깨동무를 하고 즐거운 듯이 웃고 있다!
entries.gloss: They have their arms around each other's shoulders and are laughing happily!
It returns to normal when withdrawn.

entries.korean: 그럼 유니언 룸에서 즐거운 시간을 보내십시오
entries.gloss: Then please enjoy your time in the Union Room.

entries.korean: 사실은 이미 알고 있지만 몇 번이고 보고 싶어서 말이지!
entries.gloss: Truth is, I already know, but I want to see it again and again!

entries.korean: 포켓몬이 매우 기분 좋게 자고 있다
entries.gloss: The Pokémon is sleeping very comfortably.

entries.korean: 몇 마리를 맡겨도 공짜니까 자주 이용해봐!
entries.gloss: It's free no matter how many you leave, so use it often!
For some reason it looks fun!

entries.korean: 포켓몬저택은 연구를 위해 과학자가 가끔 출입하는 것 같더군
entries.gloss: It seems scientists sometimes go in and out of the Pokémon Mansion for research.

entries.korean: 전설에 나오는 새포켓몬의 이야기야 프리져 썬더 파이어 3마리가 있어!
entries.gloss: It's a story of legendary bird Pokémon. There are three: Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres!

entries.korean: 젊은 사람들은 다들 도시로 가고 싶어하지만 난 계속 여기 있고 싶어!
entries.gloss: Young people all want to go to the city, but I want to stay here forever!

entries.korean: 공들여서 짓는 것도 좋지만 기억하기 쉬운 게 제일이지!
entries.gloss: Putting a lot of thought into a name is nice, but easy to remember is best!

entries.korean: 이 해변에는 좋은 물건이 흘러오곤 하지 난 자주 주우러 와
entries.gloss: Good things often wash up on this beach. I come to pick them up often.
It's a map of the Kanto region!

entries.korean: 날카롭고 뾰족한 부리나 뿔로 상대를 쪼아서 공격한다.
entries.gloss: Attacks by pecking the opponent with a sharp, pointed beak or horn.
Don't be cold, help him out... oh dear...

entries.korean: 인류 사상 처음으로 달 위에 서다!
entries.gloss: The first person in human history to stand on the moon!
I moved to this town recently!

entries.korean: 배틀이 끝나도 마비는 치료되지 않습니다 마비치료제로 치료합시다
entries.gloss: Paralysis isn't cured even after battle. Cure it with Parlyz Heal.

What's your purpose in coming here?

entries.korean: 너 어차피 배지 안 가지고 있잖아?
entries.gloss: You don't have any badges anyway, right?

entries.korean: 예전엔 네 팬이였지만 지금은 그때의 기세가 안 느껴져서...
entries.gloss: I used to be your fan, but I don't feel the drive you had back then...
The automatic door's lock was engaged again!

entries.korean: 실프주식회사를 점령하면 전 세계에 포켓몬을 팔아서 크게 한몫 챙길 거야!
entries.gloss: Once we take over Silph Co., we'll sell Pokémon all over the world and make a fortune!
I hear you're the one old Prof. Oak treasures?
Even though it looks shabby now!
It's a map of the Kanto region!
Maybe a boulder could block the current...
What on earth is going on?
Holding out to the end is a man's badge of honor!

entries.korean: 먼 옛날 나무에서 나온 액체가 화석처럼 굳은 것을 호박이라고 한단다
entries.gloss: Long ago, sap from trees hardened like a fossil; that's called amber.
Lives in large rivers that flow through jungles.

entries.korean: 가끔씩 회색시티까지 쇼핑하러 가는데 상록숲은 길이 많이 구부러져 있어
entries.gloss: Sometimes I go shopping in Pewter City, but the path through Viridian Forest winds a lot.

entries.korean: 탄생의 섬에 갈 때 필요한 배 티켓.
entries.gloss: A ship ticket needed to go to Birth Island.

entries.korean: 정의감이 강하고 열혈에 멋지고 가장 대단한 사람...!
entries.gloss: Someone with a strong sense of justice, hot-blooded, cool, and the most amazing...!
Are you from my fan club?
It's good to raise them slowly!
The opponent can never dodge it.
It became easier to run into Pokémon!
One morning it suddenly comes flying in.
I need to add more to my training menu!
I've been on the mountain path so long I'm dizzy...
Sinhun: If I win this, I'm going to propose to Miyeong...!
...Looks like the wind has changed direction.
Well, there's no need to force it.

entries.korean: 이 근처의 녀석한테서 억지로 빼앗아 왔다고!
entries.gloss: I forcibly took it from someone around here!
Did the Pokémon break a sweat?
Its territory is one whole huge mountain.
I did my best, so I have no regrets!
Your bike is cool. I'm jealous.

entries.korean: 아무래도 운이 없군 기분 전환이나 할까!
entries.gloss: Looks like my luck's out. Maybe I'll switch things up!

entries.korean: 배틀이 끝나도 마비는 치료되지 않습니다 마비치료제로 치료합시다
entries.gloss: Paralysis isn't cured even after battle. Cure it with Parlyz Heal.
Touching it makes you tingle and go numb.
If you touch it, you might cause a bug.

entries.korean: 태어난 뒤 등이 커지고 단단한 등껍질이 생긴다.
entries.gloss: After it's born, its back grows larger and a hard shell forms.
Attacks by slamming down muddied water hard.
It's a game where Mario walks around wearing a bucket!
Once caught, detailed data will be shown too.
It seems to be under adjustment.

entries.korean: 기분 좋은 풀피리의 음색을 들려주어 상대를 잠듦 상태로 만든다.
entries.gloss: Plays a soothing grass-flute melody to put the opponent to sleep.
It emits ultrasonic waves to close in on its target.
Takes no recoil even when it collides.

entries.korean: 안개 같은 미세한 깃털로 둘러싸 공격한다.
entries.gloss: Attacks by surrounding the opponent with fine, fog-like feathers.

entries.korean: 적의 발밑에 압정을 설치해서 교체된 포켓몬에게 데미지를 준다.
entries.gloss: Sets tacks at the enemy's feet, damaging Pokémon that switch in.

entries.korean: 긴 촉수나 덩굴 등을 휘감아서 공격한다.
entries.gloss: Attacks by wrapping long tentacles or vines around the opponent.

entries.korean: 잡은 적이 있는 포켓몬을 잡기 쉬운 조금 특이한 볼.
entries.gloss: A somewhat unusual Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon you've caught before.
